description:
WHEN: Use when your user asks whether Dantes grades work — "do Strong Buys beat SPY", "how have Dantes Buy grades done", "is the grade monotone". Returns the forward log of grades Dantes issued live, measured beside SPY over identical windows.

NOT for: Not a backtest and not evidence until its own completed-63 Buy-or-better count reaches the threshold it states — quote the as-of date and the n with every number. Not a grade for a name (that is get_dantes_rating). Needs a token; the anonymous endpoint answers token_required.

Returns: { ok, as_of, units, scopes: { dantes | storystocks | combined: { label, plain_line, completed_63 { rows, buy_or_better, ended_early, needed_buy_or_better }, by_grade[] ({ grade, rows, horizons { 5|21|63|126|252: { measured, pending, mean_excess, mean_excess_95, median_excess, hit_rate_vs_spy, … } } }), books_vs_spy { strong_buy, buy_or_better: { book, spy: { total_return, cagr, sharpe, sortino, max_drawdown, mar } } }, monotonicity_63 } } } or { ok: false, reason: token_required | no_report | report_unreadable }. Total return, dividends included; say which scope a number is from.
name: get_grade_forward_report
title: Read the forward log of Dantes grades vs SPY
